# Chapter 5 — 就买这件吧

**Pinyin:** Jiù mǎi zhè jiàn ba  
**English title:** Take this one  
**Source:** *HSK Standard Course 2*, printed pages 33–40 (source image pages 053–060).

| 2 | 准备 | zhǔnbèi | v. to intend; to plan | p. 34 |
| 3 | 就 | jiù | adv. used to indicate a conclusion or resolution | p. 34 |

## Unique Hanzi in the New Words

Listed once in order of first appearance: **外、面、准、备、就、鱼、吧、件、还、可、以、不、错、考、试、意、思、咖、啡、对、后** (21 characters).

The warm-up on p. 33 also labels **衣服、打球、休息、咖啡、考试** and **鱼**. These are picture-matching prompts, not additional New Words entries.

## Characters

The Characters section on printed p. 38 introduces the single-component characters **鱼** (yú, fish) and **衣** (yī, clothes), with their historical forms and writing practice. It also presents two radicals:

- **子字旁** (子 radical), generally associated with children; example characters **孩** (hái, child) and **孙** (sūn, grandson).
- **广字头** (广 radical), generally associated with buildings; example characters **店** (diàn, shop/store) and **床** (chuáng, bed).
